name: C.I.D Praha s.r.o.
summary: Czech arms supplier and SME based in Prague. It wins weapons contracts from the Czech Ministry of the Interior (Police of the Czech Republic) and the Ministry of Defence. Its main business on TED is 4.6×30 mm personal defence weapons (PDW submachine guns), supplied under framework agreements with spare parts and accessories. It also supplies spare parts and components for police long-gun systems. All its TED awards are in CPV 35300000.

name: Fabrica de Municiones de Granada S.L.
summary: Large Spanish ammunition manufacturer based in Granada and a regular supplier to the Spanish Army Logistics Support Command. It wins contracts for 105 mm and 155 mm field artillery ammunition (one 105 mm award was about EUR 22M) and 76/62 mm naval practice rounds. It also supplies special explosive shaped charges, including to the Guardia Civil.

name: Fabryka Broni "ŁUCZNIK"-Radom Sp. z o.o.
summary: Polish state-group small-arms manufacturer in Radom (Łucznik), maker of the MSBS GROT rifle. On TED it mostly wins spare parts, service and repair kits, gauges, special tools, and UTM training-ammunition conversion kits for Polish Army small arms. It supplies these to Regional Logistics Bases 1 and 2, often as call-offs under framework agreement 19/W/2024. Platforms covered include the 5.56 mm MSBS GROT and the 9 mm PM-84P and PM-98 submachine guns.

name: Metallwerk Elisenhütte
summary: Large German small-arms ammunition manufacturer in Nassau. It supplies BAAINBw/Bundeswehr, German customs and federal and state police forces (Bavaria, Hesse, Saxony-Anhalt), plus at least one award from the Dutch Ministry of Defence. Products are 5.56×45 mm (hard-core DM31, soft-core DM41A1, blank and manoeuvre rounds), 7.62×51 mm duty ammunition and 9×19 mm duty, training and frangible rounds, often under framework agreements. Its largest recent award was 5.56 mm blanks at about EUR 16.9M.

name: TRANSCARPAT SPORTOURS INTERNATIONAL
summary: Medium-sized Romanian defence and security trading company in Bucharest. It supplies the Romanian MoD (several military units), the Romanian Police, the Border Police, the Penitentiary Police and the emergency services (IGSU). Its core line is ammunition in many calibres (7.62×25, 7.65×17, 9×19, 12.7×99 mm, lethal and less-lethal) plus service firearms. It also sells specialist optical instruments, endoscopes, training simulators, military vehicle parts and sports equipment.
